US Committed to Defending Strait of Hormuz Amid Houthi Threat

US Senator Marco Rubio stated that the United States will "continue to defend" the Strait of Hormuz. He also affirmed the US commitment to a defense agreement with Saudi Arabia, in the context of threats from the Houthis.
